fields.hair: long wavy hair with brown base and lighter balayage/highlights, center part, falling past shoulders
fields.stature: tall, slim proportions based on visible leg-to-torso ratio

fields.torso_length: slim torso, visible in fitted top
fields.bust_proportions: medium, visible under fitted tank top
fields.hip_proportions: hips slightly wider than waist, proportionate to frame

skipped_newer.why_not: ['bust_proportions'] could not be read off this pack's frames. A frozen identity with an unstated dimension is a dimension that can never drift again, which is the owner's unmeasurable-is-never-pass rule made permanent rather than broken once

freeze.why_those_were_skipped: a newer build that could not state a required dimension is not a newer identity, it is an unusable one. Naming them keeps the choice auditable rather than looking like the newest pack was taken
freeze.superseded_stay_evidence: the pre-revision body pack and the five rejected tournament finalists remain in the audit log and cannot be promoted: nothing selects them, and `select_canonical` refuses a second canonical outright

evidence.bust_proportions: medium, visible under fitted tank top
evidence.torso_length: slim torso, visible in fitted top

checks.why_it_matters: a pack read back with a blank field is a dimension that can never drift again, and one with no reference image is a description of a woman nobody can produce or check against
a different face on the right body is a different woman
two independent floors, reported independently or they average
the owner named chest/bust and torso as hard floors; a set that cannot see them has not checked the body
a frame nobody could read is the case a blended score waves through
the exact failure the owner named: a familiar face stops anybody looking further down the frame

blocking: listing-hero: only 0 face dimensions were readable, below the floor of 3; ['bust', 'torso'] could not be read, and chest/bust and torso continuity are hard-floor dimensions rather than two of eight to be counted in with the rest. Unmeasurable is not a pass

checks.why_it_matters: an unjudged model frame must block, and a product-only frame must not be held up by a check that does not apply to it

enforcement.note: Run against the pack read back out of the database, because the question is whether the identity that survived persistence is the one being enforced. The observations are synthetic and that is the point: a drifted body under a matching face is not something a generator produces on request, and waiting for one would mean never checking it.

approval.decision: approve and freeze the revised canonical Brambleloop model reference pack
approval.includes: the revised torso/full-length morphology and bust/chest proportion
approval.superseded: the pre-revision body pack and the rejected tournament finalists remain historical evidence and are never eligible for automatic selection
approval.does_not_authorise: Etsy publication, advertising, customer communication or any other live launch action. Shadow Mode stands
